translations.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
translations.bsb: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
translations.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
